issues.description: An axiom placed directly below the block of a selected premise that is not an ASSUMPTION (a code-less GOAL or DERIVATION card, which preflight accepts as a premise) becomes that card's statement. It then escapes every axiom rule, and a non-Prop one enters the permitted set. Three gaps combine. (1) new-axiom: isBelief (core/src/gate/rules.ts:154-161) returns false for any card-owned axiom that is not the card's .holds. (2) vocabulary-shape (rules.ts:401-414) never sees it: owned declarations are not vocabulary (project/build.ts ~line 374). (3) Readiness (rules.ts:420-421) checks only the target and selected ASSUMPTIONs or ghosts, so a TL113 'not a Prop abbrev' statement on a GOAL premise is ignored. Finally signatureAxioms (core/src/gate/permitted.ts:141-150) admits every axiom whose type is not a Prop. With `axiom side_goal : Empty` the freeze's permitted list contained Spyro.side_goal, and comparator accepted `Empty.elim side_goal`. The Prop-typed variant (P6b) lets Claude add a belief that a not-proved Accept writes into the user's file, against 'only you can add beliefs'.
issues.evidence: P1, real Lean. Premises ['side-goal'] (a user's code-less GOAL card). Freeze reply: 'Your proofs may rest only on these axioms: … Spyro.side_goal …'. Gate passed on attempt 1, verdict proved, no notice, no definition question. Report card footprint: [presup:Character.exists, presup:Game.exists, axiom:Spyro.side_goal], with side-goal listed as 'unused'. Accept ok ('These suffice → proved … (+ Make Derivation)'). The real Main.lean now holds `axiom side_goal : Empty` and `theorem cynder_not_good.holds : cynder_not_good := Empty.elim side_goal`; after refresh the board shows a DERIVATION with proof.kind 'proved'. P6b: `axiom side_goal : ¬ GoodAddition cynder newSpyro` under the same card, finish not_proved: gate passed, Accept wrote it into the real Main.lean. Files: p1-result.json and p6b-result.json in the scratch folder.
issues.suggested_fix: In evaluateRules, treat every axiom added since B that is not the .holds of a selected ASSUMPTION or ghost, and not a vocabulary item of an allowed shape, as a new-axiom finding: a card's statement must never be an axiom. Apply not-formalised (TL101/TL113) to every selected premise bound in the run, not only ASSUMPTIONs. Make signatureAxioms admit only axioms classified as sort, predicate or presupposition vocabulary (no shape-violation), not every axiom whose type is not a Prop. Add regression tests with a GOAL and a DERIVATION premise in core and in walkthrough.e2e.

issues.description: The permitted set is circular for selected GOAL or DERIVATION premises whose proof Claude writes in the run. Derivation footprints come from the premises' proofs in the CURRENT state (permitted.ts contribution(), lines 153-162 and 182-190). In a not-proved finish, rules.ts:345 uses permittedAxioms(current, Sel), so a run-added proof of a selected premise is checked against a set that contains its own footprint, and passes whatever it rests on. A later freeze (Feedback or adoption round; proof-before-freeze only looks at the current round) then bakes that footprint into the permitted set. The target can then be 'proved' from an unselected assumption, even used directly, and G4 agrees because comparator gets that list.
issues.evidence: P2, real Lean. Premises ['cynder-dark-past','pg-no-dark-past','side-goal'] (new-spyro-pg NOT selected). Round 1: `abbrev side_goal : Prop := new_spyro_pg` and `theorem side_goal.holds : side_goal := new_spyro_pg.holds`, finish not_proved: 'Gate passed'. Feedback, round 2: the freeze reply lists Spyro.new_spyro_pg.holds as permitted; `theorem cynder_not_good.holds := pg_no_dark_past.holds newSpyro cynder new_spyro_pg.holds cynder_dark_past.holds` gets 'Gate passed', verdict proved, Accept ok ('These suffice → proved …'). The real Main.lean has that proof while its premises line still reads 'cynder-dark-past, pg-no-dark-past, side-goal'. The only hints are new-spyro-pg in the report-card footprint and side-goal marked unused. Round 1 alone would also have let Accept write a lemma resting on an unselected assumption (plan item 26). File: p2-result.json in the scratch folder.
issues.suggested_fix: Take derivation footprints only from premise .holds proofs unchanged since B (or the accept-base commit), never from proofs added or changed in the run. Compute the not-proved permitted set the same way (from B's proofs) so it cannot include the footprint it is judging. Add tests: a selected GOAL/DERIVATION premise proved in round 1 from an unselected assumption must fail in round 1 and must not widen the round-2 freeze after Feedback or adoption.

issues.description: The footprint rule fails open when a run-added proof has no facts under its source name. A `private theorem` is stored in Lean's facts under a mangled name, so factsOf returns nothing and rules.ts:361 (`if (!permitted || !f) continue;`) skips it silently in every purpose. A not-proved round can therefore carry a lemma resting on an unselected assumption into the user's files, which plan item 26 / decision 10 forbids. It cannot produce a false 'proved': the target's own axioms and comparator still see the dependency.
issues.evidence: P12, real Lean. Premises ['cynder-dark-past','pg-no-dark-past']. `private theorem helper_priv : new_spyro_pg := new_spyro_pg.holds`, finish not_proved: 'Gate passed', verdict not-proved; Accept ok; the real Main.lean contains helper_priv. Control P11 (the same dependency through a public `instance … : Nonempty new_spyro_pg`) was caught: 'footprint: … rests on Spyro.new_spyro_pg.holds … not selected'. File: p3-result.json in the scratch folder.
issues.suggested_fix: Fail closed: in evaluateRules, any proof added or changed in the run without matching facts (or without an axiom list) is a footprint finding in every gate purpose, not only when facts exist but lack axioms. Alternatively resolve private names in the facts lookup (core factsIndex).

The failure path works end to end on real Lean (P11, P6 first script): 'Attempt 1 didn't pass …' notice, then the nudge, then a no-finish revert to 'Your files at the start of the run'; the proposal shown never contained the refused text.
